name: Creative Camp
description_short: A half-day music, arts and conservation camp for ages 5–10, held Monday to Thursday mornings at the Levitate Backyard in Marshfield, MA. Kids are grouped by age, go on walking trips into nature, and do daily workshops with local artists, farmers, photographers and chefs. The curriculum changes each week.
activities: Art projects in a range of mediums
Learning about bees and pollinator plants
refund_policy_summary: The 10% deposit is non-refundable. Cancel 60+ days before the start for a 90% refund, or 30–59 days before for a 50% refund. No refund within 30 days of the start, during a session, or for missed days. All fees are refunded if camp is cancelled for public health reasons. You can switch sessions for free if space allows.
